notes: Arrange Home your way: Edit Home lets you drag, resize and remove its cards, with Undo and Reset
Add a widget: a note, a scratch pad, a deck, a shelf, a document, a countdown, study time, a goal ring and more
Home's cards use the room they are given: on a wide card they lay out in columns instead of a long strip
On a phone, put Home's cards in the order you want and take away the ones you do not
